en.title: Choose the Best Flask
en.description:
Choose one flask type that can serve all orders and minimizes the total waste, i.e. marked capacity minus order volume; break ties by the smallest type index.

The standard input/output format and supplementary bounds on this site are as defined in this problem statement.
en.input: n (1≤n≤1000); the next line contains n order volumes (1..10^9); then f (1≤f≤1000), followed by one line per flask type: first the number of markings, then the markings in ascending order. The total number of markings is ≤2×10^5.
en.output: Output the 0-based flask type index; if no type can serve all orders, output -1.
en.explanation: For each type's markings, use a monotonic pointer to find, for each order, the first marking not less than the order volume; accumulate the waste and take the minimum by `(waste,index)`. An independent oracle linearly enumerates all markings for each order.
